summary: Lays out architectural principles for a quantum internet, a network that lets distant nodes share quantum entanglement. It explains how a quantum network stack differs from the classical one and sketches the building blocks, such as repeaters and entangled pairs. It is an informational framework, not a protocol specification.

eli5.summary: Imagine two friends with magic coins that always land the same way, even far apart. This document is a plan for building a network that links such magic coins across the whole world.

questions: how does a quantum network stack work
what is quantum entanglement in networking
